entities.summary: Raphael of Saint Joseph Kalinowski was a Polish Carmelite, social activist, participant in the January Uprising, and a saint of the Catholic Church. Before his conversion, he served in the Imperial Russian Army, fought in the January Uprising in Lithuania and was exiled to Siberia.
